description: Welcome to 4504 H Street a storybook 1940s East Sacramento home blending timeless character with artistic warmth and thoughtful updates throughout. Perfectly situated on the border of the coveted Fabulous 40s, this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath home lives much larger than its footprint and offers an inviting mix of vintage detail, natural light, and seamless indoor-outdoor living.  From the moment you arrive, the home's curb appeal shines with its welcoming front yard, classic architecture, circular driveway, and multiple off-street parking spaces. Inside, warm red oak hardwood floors, graceful archways, original custom tile work, and a charming pass-through pantry celebrate the home's authentic character. Large windows throughout including several floor-to-ceiling  flood the home with natural light and create an airy, cheerful ambiance . The vintage kitchen and  bath details give it a warm and inviting feel. and a floor plan with beautiful circular flow and functionality.  The cozy living room centers around a classic fireplace and flows effortlessly into a sunroom framed by double French doors that open to an expansive deck ideal for morning coffee, entertaining, or relaxing under the trees. The private fenced backyard offers multiple gathering spaces, including a large deck, patio, and firepit area surrounded by mature landscaping and bamboo for added privacy.  Conveniently located near Trader Joe's, local coffee shops, restaurants, and parks, 4504 H Street offers a rare chance to own a home of exceptional character. Brimming with warmth, East Sac charm, and a unique personality, it stands as a truly special residence in one of the city's most cherished neighborhoods.
